claim: The operation is the first of its kind in the UK, and only the second reported to have taken place worldwide.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: Health Tech World, 8 Oct 2026: 'The operation, carried out in August, is the first of its kind in the UK and only the second reported worldwide', by clinicians at NHS Lothian; Positron (8 Oct 08:04): 'the first person in the UK to receive a transplant of his own testicular tissue'. Borderline on independence: both read like the same release. The first worldwide was the Brussels case (VUB, 2025-26). The Edinburgh Evening News refused the fetch (403).
